label: MODEL_FREE_CEILING
method: Near-miss census on V32 (finalized) waited-and-lost rests (terminal_reason RESTING_ORDER_NEVER_RECEIVED_LATER_SELLER_AGGRESSED_PRINT). Rest TRAJECTORY reconstructed from the full decision trace (PLACE/REPRICE target_cents over time); at each seller-aggressed print (prints.jsonl taker_side=='no') the gap = print_price - ACTIVE walked-down rest level. 1c/2c/3c ABOVE = sellers who stopped just short of our resting bid. Implied joint: convert 1c near-miss (fill at rest level) -> game joint if sibling V32-credited, both below close, sum<100.
